items.headline: U.S. Treasury Permanently Ends Beneficial Ownership Reporting for American Small Businesses
items.summary: The U.S. Department of the Treasury's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network issued a final rule permanently exempting domestic companies and individuals from reporting beneficial ownership information under the Corporate Transparency Act [2.1.1]. FinCEN also confirmed it will purge previously collected data on U.S. persons while retaining disclosure mandates for foreign entities operating in the country.

items.headline: Rare Total Solar Eclipse Sweeps Across Europe and the Arctic
items.summary: On August 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse is sweeping across Greenland, Iceland, and northern Spain, marking the first total solar eclipse visible in mainland Europe in 27 years. Space agencies including NASA are deploying high-altitude research aircraft and scientific balloons along the path of totality to study the sun's outer atmosphere during the event.

items.headline: Iga Świątek Reaches First WTA 1000 Semifinal of 2026 at Canadian Open
items.summary: Six-time Grand Slam champion Iga Świątek defeated Diana Shnaider 6-2, 6-1 in 68 minutes at the Canadian Open in Toronto. The dominant quarterfinal win advances Świątek to her first WTA 1000 semifinal of the 2026 season as top players build momentum ahead of the US Open.

items.headline: Brad Pitt Suggests AI Could Help Save Mid-Budget Hollywood Films
items.summary: In a newly released cover story for Esquire, Oscar-winning actor Brad Pitt stated that artificial intelligence could help mid-budget movies get produced by lowering visual effects costs [3.1.1]. His comments have stirred widespread industry debate over the practical and creative boundaries of AI in filmmaking.
